OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Deposit(address,address,address,uint256,.details: Emitted when an asset is deposited into the PSM.

params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the resulting shares from the deposit.
params.sharesMinted: Number of shares minted to the user.
params.user: Address of the user that deposited the asset.

PocketSet(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when a new pocket is set in the PSM, transferring the balance of USDC.         of the old pocket to the new pocket.

params.amountTransferred: Amount of USDC transferred from the old pocket to the new pocket.

Swap(address,address,address,address,uin.details: Emitted when an asset is swapped in the PSM.

params.amountIn: Amount of the asset swapped in.
params.amountOut: Amount of the asset swapped out.
params.assetIn: Address of the asset swapped in.
params.assetOut: Address of the asset swapped out.
params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the swap.
params.sender: Address of the sender of the swap.

Withdraw(address,address,address,uint256.details: Emitted when an asset is withdrawn from the PSM.

params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the withdrawn assets.
params.sharesBurned: Number of shares burned from the user.
params.user: Address of the user that withdrew the asset.

convertToAssetValue(uint256).details: View function that converts an amount of a given shares to the equivalent          amount of assetValue.

params.numShares: Number of shares to convert to assetValue.

returns._0: assetValue Value of assets in USDC denominated in 18 decimals.

convertToAssets(address,uint256).details: View function that converts an amount of a given shares to the equivalent amount of          assets for a specified asset.

params.asset: Address of the asset to use to convert.
params.numShares: Number of shares to convert to assets.

returns._0: assets    Value of assets in asset-native units.

convertToShares(address,uint256).details: View function that converts an amount of a given asset to shares in the PSM based          on the current exchange rate. Note that this rounds down on calculation so is          intended to be used for quoting the current exchange rate.

params.asset: Address of the ERC-20 asset to convert to shares.
params.assets: Amount of assets in asset-native units.

returns._0: shares Number of shares that the assetValue is equivalent to.

convertToShares(uint256).details: View function that converts an amount of assetValue (18 decimal value denominated in          USDC and USDS) to shares in the PSM based on the current exchange rate.          Note that this rounds down on calculation so is intended to be used for quoting the          current exchange rate.

params.assetValue: 18 decimal value denominated in USDC (e.g., 1e6 USDC = 1e18)

returns._0: shares     Number of shares that the assetValue is equivalent to.

deposit(address,address,uint256).details: Deposits an amount of a given asset into the PSM. Must be one of the supported          assets in order to succeed. The amount deposited is converted to shares based on          the current exchange rate.

params.asset: Address of the ERC-20 asset to deposit.
params.assetsToDeposit: Amount of the asset to deposit into the PSM.
params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the resulting shares from the deposit.

returns.newShares: Number of shares minted to the user.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

previewSwapExactIn(address,address,uint2.details: View function that returns the exact amount of assetOut that would be received for a         given amount of assetIn in a swap. The amount returned is converted based on the         current value of the two assets used in the swap.

params.amountIn: Amount of the asset to swap in.
params.assetIn: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap in.
params.assetOut: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap out.

returns.amountOut: Amount of the asset that will be received in the swap.

previewSwapExactOut(address,address,uint.details: View function that returns the exact amount of assetIn that would be required to         receive a given amount of assetOut in a swap. The amount returned is         converted based on the current value of the two assets used in the swap.

params.amountOut: Amount of the asset to receive from the swap.
params.assetIn: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap in.
params.assetOut: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap out.

returns.amountIn: Amount of the asset that is required to receive amountOut.

previewWithdraw(address,uint256).details: View function that returns the exact number of assets that would be withdrawn and          corresponding shares that would be burned in a withdrawal for a given asset and max          withdraw amount. The amount returned is the minimum of the balance of the PSM,          the max amount, and the max amount of assets that the user's shares          can be converted to.

params.asset: Address of the ERC-20 asset to withdraw.
params.maxAssetsToWithdraw: Max amount that the user is willing to withdraw.

returns.assetsWithdrawn: Resulting amount of the asset withdrawn from the PSM.
returns.sharesToBurn: Number of shares that would be burned in the withdrawal.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPocket(address).details: Sets the address of the pocket, an address that holds custody of USDC in the PSM          and can deploy it to yield-bearing strategies. This function will transfer the          balance of USDC in the PSM to the new pocket. Callable only by the owner.

swapExactIn(address,address,uint256,uint.details: Swaps a specified amount of assetIn for assetOut in the PSM. The amount swapped is          converted based on the current value of the two assets used in the swap. This          function will revert if there is not enough balance in the PSM to facilitate the          swap. Both assets must be supported in the PSM in order to succeed.

params.amountIn: Amount of the asset to swap in.
params.assetIn: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap in.
params.assetOut: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap out.
params.minAmountOut: Minimum amount of the asset to receive.
params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the swapped assets.

returns.amountOut: Resulting amount of the asset that will be received in the swap.

swapExactOut(address,address,uint256,uin.details: Swaps a derived amount of assetIn for a specific amount of assetOut in the PSM. The          amount swapped is converted based on the current value of the two assets used in          the swap. This function will revert if there is not enough balance in the PSM to          facilitate the swap. Both assets must be supported in the PSM in order to succeed.

params.amountOut: Amount of the asset to receive from the swap.
params.assetIn: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap in.
params.assetOut: Address of the ERC-20 asset to swap out.
params.maxAmountIn: Max amount of the asset to use for the swap.
params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the swapped assets.

returns.amountIn: Resulting amount of the asset swapped in.

totalAssets().details: View function that returns the total value of the balance of all assets in the PSM       converted to USDC/USDS terms denominated in 18 decimal precision.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(address,address,uint256).details: Withdraws an amount of a given asset from the PSM up to `maxAssetsToWithdraw`.          Must be one of the supported assets in order to succeed. The amount withdrawn is          the minimum of the balance of the PSM, the max amount, and the max amount of assets          that the user's shares can be converted to.

params.asset: Address of the ERC-20 asset to withdraw.
params.maxAssetsToWithdraw: Max amount that the user is willing to withdraw.
params.receiver: Address of the receiver of the withdrawn assets.

returns.assetsWithdrawn: Resulting amount of the asset withdrawn from the PSM.

pocket.details: Returns the address of the pocket, an address that holds custody of USDC in the          PSM and can deploy it to yield-bearing strategies. Settable by the owner.

rateProvider.details: Returns the address of the rate provider, a contract that provides the conversion          rate between sUSDS and the other two assets in the PSM (e.g., sUSDS to USD).
rateProvider.return: The address of the rate provider.

returns._0: The address of the rate provider.

shares.details: Returns the number of shares held by a specific user.
shares.return: shares The number of shares held by the user.

returns.shares: The number of shares held by the user.

susds.details: Returns the IERC20 interface representing sUSDS. This asset is the yield-bearing          asset in the PSM. The value of this asset is queried from the rate provider.

totalShares.details: Returns the total number of shares in the PSM. Shares represent ownership of the          assets in the PSM and can be converted to assets at any time.

usdc.details: Returns the IERC20 interface representing USDC.

usds.details: Returns the IERC20 interface representing USDS.
